name: Vignette® Modern Roman Shades
description: Vignette® Modern Roman Shades feature consistent folds with no exposed rear cords, creating a clean, tailored look in both raised and lowered positions.

Operating Systems
LiteRise®
Cordless manual operation for 
premium child and pet safety. 
Use the attached handle to raise 
and lower.
UltraGlide®
A single retractable wand for  
enhanced child safety. To lower,  
pull wand toward center of shade. 
To raise, pull wand straight down  
or to the outside of shade.
EasyRise™
A continuous cord loop system. 
Pull on front or rear of cord to 
operate shade. Cord tensioner 
mounts to window frame.

can be strangled by cords. Immediately remove 
this product if a cord longer than 22 cm or a loop 
exceeding 44 cm around becomes accessible.

OPERATING SYSTEMS
AND OPTIONS

Top-Down/Bottom-Up 
The shade can be opened from the top or bottom for a greater range of  
light control. Available in 4" full fold stacking style in all opacities.
Specialty Shapes  
From arches to angles, Vignette® shades can cover many specialty shapes. 
They are non-operable and available exclusively as inside mount.
Accents by the Yard™   
Every Vignette fabric is offered as cut yardage, so you can create  
coordinating home accents like pillows and duvets.
Duolite® 
The Vignette® Duolite front shade and room-darkening back panel both  
roll into a single headrail for the ultimate in light control and privacy.
4" Full Fold 
This design features soft, cascading fabric folds. Available in rolling  
and stacking styles.
Two-On-One Headrail 
Two independently operated shades can share the same headrail. Available in 
rolling and stacking styles, and in 4" full fold and 6" flat fold in all opacities.
6" Flat Fold   
This design features non-dimensional fabric folds. Available exclusively 
in rolling style.

Style Comparison
Stacking Style 
The only stacking Roman shade without exposed lift cords on the back. Shade 
stacks neatly when raised or lowered. Fabric-covered, low-profile headrail houses 
innovative operating systems. 
Rolling Style 
The only Roman shade without internal lift cords. Shade rolls up and away  
into a fabric-covered headrail for a consistent look and unobstructed views.

Duolite® Dual Opacity Design Option
Blocks majority of light when desired with a room-darkening panel 
that operates sequentially with a sheer or light-filtering face fabric
Sheer
Provides the most natural light and view-through with minimal privacy
